statusRule: original = bundled assets/sprites/pokemon/{front,back,icon}/<id>.png all exist; partial = some; fallback = none (procedural placeholder). assets-local/ is ignored.

tierRules.1: starters and their lines; Part 1 wild tables (no pN_ prefix); Part 1 rival (rival_*); gym 1-2 (gym1_*, gym2_*, p1_leader_*)
tierRules.2: leader, elite and champion teams; wild tables of Routes 5-9 (p2_route5-8, p3a_route9)
tierRules.3: every other species used by wild tables, trainers, gifts, eggs, static battles or events
